messages.content: I’ll commit a day-ahead book that pairs battery sales in the higher-priced hours with feasible reserve awards, then monitor the day and adjust energy as notices arrive. AS awards will be fixed after this watch.

The day-ahead book was accepted in full. Regulation has since added more charge than expected and triggered some controller discharge, using part of the daily discharge limit. I’m reducing afternoon charging and adjusting the remaining sales to stay within that limit and support the fixed reserves.
